info.title: API.SH: MediaMarkt
info.description: The MediaMarkt API from API.SH: public MediaMarkt data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of one MediaMarkt or Saturn category with the same fields, filters, sorts and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mediamarkt-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category number (e.g. 579 for smartphones in Germany), a CAT_DE_MM_579 id from `categories`, or a /category/<name>-579.html link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, bestseller, newest, availability.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Facet filters as `field:value` from `facets[].values[].filter` (e.g. brand:SAMSUNG); several separated by |.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first (the shop shows up to 30 pages of 12). Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country: de (default), at, ch, nl, be, es, it (MediaWorld), pl.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.title: GOOGLE Pixel 10a 128 GB Obsidian Dual SIM

get.description:
One MediaMarkt or Saturn product: title, brand, EAN, kind, release date, price, promo and strike-through price, installments, VAT rate, delivery and pickup status and dates, every image, the full specification table by group, variants (colour, storage) with their product ids, energy label and data sheet, rating, rating distribution and the latest 10 reviews (title, text, pros, cons, stars, date, verified purchase, helpful votes, reviewed variant), marketplace offers from other sellers (price, condition, seller rating, delivery), and the service plans offered with it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mediamarkt-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The number at the end of a product link (e.g. 3013585), or the link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country: de (default), at, ch, nl, be, es, it (MediaWorld), pl.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: APPLE iPhone 17 Pro 5G 256 GB Silber Dual SIM

get.description:
MediaMarkt and Saturn product search in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Italy (MediaWorld) and Poland: product id, title, brand, EAN, link, image, price, promo and strike-through price, discount, installments, shipping cost, rating and review count, online, delivery and store-pickup status with delivery dates, marketplace seller, badges, energy class, highlighted specs and category path. `facets` lists every filter the shop offers for the query (categories, brands, price range, rating, specs, seller) with counts and a ready `filter` value. When the shop answers a query with a category, the category's results come back with `redirected_to_category`; when it answers with a topic page, `suggested_categories` lists the categories it links. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mediamarkt-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, bestseller, newest, availability.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Facet filters as `field:value` from `facets[].values[].filter` (e.g. brand:SAMSUNG); several separated by |.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first (the shop shows up to 30 pages of 12). Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country: de (default), at, ch, nl, be, es, it (MediaWorld), pl.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
